title: The Representation of the People (Absent Voting at Local Government Elections) (Scotland) Amendment Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Representation of the People (Absent Voting at Local Government Elections) (Scotland) Regulation 2007 (“the 2007 Regulations”).

title: The Scottish Local Government Elections Amendment Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Scottish Local Government Elections Order 2011 (“the 2011 Order”).

The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 3 and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (c. 20) (“the 2026 Act”). These are the third commencement regulations made under the 2026 Act.

title: The Employment Rights Act 2025 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary:
These Regulations bring into force, on 1st October 2026, 
section 152 of, and 
Schedule 12 to, the 
Employment Rights Act 2025 (c. 36) (“the 2025 Act”), which extend time limits for instituting claims to employment tribunals from three to six months.

title: The Personal Injuries (NHS Charges) (Information Provision and Amounts) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Personal Injuries (NHS Charges) (General) and Road Traffic (NHS Charges) (Amendment) Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/3388) (“the 2006 Regulations”) and the Personal Injuries (NHS Charges) (Amounts) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/295) (“the 2015 Regulations”). The 2006 and 2015 Regulations form part of the legislative framework of the injury cost recovery scheme under Part 3 of the Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 (c. 43).

summary: These Regulations make amendments to the National Health Service (Pharmaceutical and Local Pharmaceutical Services) Regulations 2013 (the PLPS Regulations). The PLPS Regulations govern arrangements, in England, for the provision of pharmaceutical services and local pharmaceutical services under Part 7 of the National Health Service Act 2006.

The Sports Grounds and Sporting Events (Designation) (Scotland) Amendment Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Sports Grounds and Sporting Events (Designation) (Scotland) Order 2014 (“the 2014 Order”). The 2014 Order designates sports grounds, classes of sporting events played at those grounds and classes of sporting events outside Great Britain for the purposes of Part II of the Criminal Law (Consolidation) (Scotland) Act 1995 (sporting events: control of alcohol etc.).

title: The Air Departure Tax (Scotland) Act 2017 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force section 2, section 8, section 15, section 17(4) and (5) (for the purpose of making regulations under section 17(4)), and section 41 of the Air Departure Tax (Scotland) Act 2017 (“the Act”) on 15 September 2026.

title: The Charges for Residues Surveillance Amendment (Scotland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Charges for Residues Surveillance Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/2285) as they apply in Scotland.
